chunks.arabic_text: عَدَدٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ:

translations.en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sulayman ibn Ja'far who said: I heard al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying:

chunks.arabic_text: إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِمْ السَّلَامُ، وَامْرَأَتَهُ وَبَنِيهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَنْ عَرَفَ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ مِنْ وَلَدِ عَلِيٍّ وَفَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ لَمْ يَكُنْ كَالنَّاسِ.

translations.en: Indeed, Ali ibn Ubaydallah ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them), his wife, and his children are from the people of Paradise. Then he said: Whoever acknowledges this affair from the descendants of Ali and Fatima (peace be upon them) is not like the people.

en.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the specific status of Ali ibn Ubaydallah (the Shahid) and his family as inhabitants of Paradise, linking their spiritual excellence to their lineage from the Ahl al-Bayt. Al-Rida emphasizes that true recognition of Wilayah among the progeny of Ali and Fatima creates a distinct spiritual identity, setting them apart from the general populace in both knowledge and divine favor.
en.seo_question: Who are the descendants of Ali and Fatima mentioned as being from the people of Paradise in al-Kafi?
